record.question: The Portuguese explorer Vasco da Gama first landed in India at
record.explanation: Answer D: Calicut. Vasco da Gama landed at Calicut (Kozhikode) in 1498. Reference: https://www.britannica.com/biography/Vasco-da-Gama. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
